checks.name: Undo commits a typed draft before undoing it, and Redo restores its value
Invalid drafts prevent playback and preserve the current document
Nested document cancellation retains the outer transaction
Serialization failure retains outer and nested transactions for cancellation
Selection follows UUID when numeric IDs change during hydration
Rejected entity and numeric records leave the complete open document unchanged
Undo preserves an unresolved external scene conflict
Explicit focus/navigation booleans survive all combinations; unreachable authored controls remain diagnosed
Late component normalization failure restores settings, assets, selection and scene conflict state
A document replacement inside a named merge transaction remains one reversible edit
Rejected hydration retains an open outer transaction for commit
Replacing a removed collider preserves both identities and applies the live collider geometry/material
Unlimited, zero, finite and very large joint thresholds survive copy/paste and JSON hydration
Scene creation and Back/Forward settle drafts into the outgoing scene, never the destination
Invalid pending drafts block scene mutation and missing targets preserve selection and document
Prefab apply/revert and Undo preserve instance identity, overrides, source asset and selection
Every declared scalar component enum rejects invalid API and load values before mutation
A non-finite nested paste leaves the entire component unchanged
No-op boundaries preserve redo and discrete actions on one resource remain separate
Merge application settles pending drafts before checking preview freshness
A current reviewed merge applies as one reversible edit; invalid drafts leave the preview and document intact
Component paste cannot replace a prototype or inherited constructor
Project-test startup rejects invalid drafts before snapshot replacement
A valid draft is included in the project-test snapshot and survives test restoration
Invalid entity ownership and persistence enums reject atomically at API and load boundaries
Identical text-asset writes leave source metadata, generation and document history unchanged
Recent-project bookkeeping preserves the saved document and the redo branch
Legacy rope thresholds preserve unlimited, zero and large finite values through normalization and JSON
Projects containing unlimited legacy ropes serialize and reopen with the same thresholds
New text assets preserve complete metadata through their first document Undo and Redo
